changelog: Better speech recognition, and your phone becomes a real companion. Meeting transcripts should be noticeably cleaner - the old speech engine had a habit of inventing words during silence, so a quiet stretch could come back as "Thank you." and get filed away as though someone said it. The new one doesn't do that. Your phone can now reach much more of what's on this PC: search everything (screen history, documents, transcripts, messages), read your documents, see the people you deal with along with what you owe them, and view your day plan - plus it runs its own timers and writes you a morning brief. Contacts: tell DensAssistant that "Bob" is also Robert Chen and it treats them as one person everywhere, including spelling their name correctly in transcripts.
